title: Inquest called on police
article: An inquest has been called into the high-profile death of a Winnipeg man following a confrontation with police last year near Kapyong Barracks.
Mark Dicesare, 24, was shot and killed by as many as five Winnipeg cops on a field near the intersection of Grant Avenue and Kenaston Boulevard on Nov. 6, 2015.

Police had started to chase Dicesare minutes earlier after spotting him driving erratically in the Tuxedo area early that afternoon. Witnesses reported Dicesare had been waving a gun during a subsequent chase. He was shot multiple times following a 20-minute standoff with police in the field near the intersection.

Inquests are automatically called whenever police are directly involved in the death of a person. The inquest, to happen at an unspecified time in the future, will investigate the circumstances relating to Dicesare's death and what, if anything, can be done to prevent similar deaths from happening again.
